```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 1

```

This Rmd runs functions for the outputs of application results in Lim et al.

```{r setup}
library(PopGenBounds)
library(patchwork)

dir_path <- "C:/Users/limy/OneDrive - International Agency for Research on Cancer/Documents/NoahCollab/code/output"
```


## Load genotype data and allele frequencies
```{r}
toad_genotypes <- PopGenBounds::toad_genotypes
Toad_microsat_freq = PopGenBounds::Toad_microsat_freq

# fix allele order for each locus
lv   <- microsat_allele_levels(toad_genotypes)
```

## Run (or load) bootstrap on global population (K = 47)

```{r run global bootstrap}
set.seed(2021)
res <- boot_stat(toad_genotypes, stat_fun = Diff, B = 1000, type="percentile")
res$mean             # check the labels in the 'statistic' column
```
```{r save bootstrap output}
saveRDS(res, file.path(dir_path, "global_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
```

```{r load saved bootstrap object}
boot_res_global <- readRDS(file.path(dir_path, "global_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
names(boot_res_global)
```
## Plot statistics distributions for global comparison

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
get <- function(s) sapply(res$estimate, function(d) d$value[d$statistic == s])

ggtoad <- ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"), GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
                       K = 47, ci = res$mean, density_colors = FALSE, ci_style="bands")

ggtoad[[1]] + ggtoad[[2]] + ggtoad[[3]]
```
## Run (or load) pairwise bootstrap (K = 2)

```{r}
set.seed(2021)
res_pw <- boot_pairwise(toad_genotypes, B = 1000)
```
```{r save boot output}
saveRDS(res_pw, file.path(dir_path, "pairwise_bootstrap_B1000_monomorph_excluded.rds"))
```

```{r check mono exclusion}
pts <- do.call(rbind, res_pw$estimate)
get <- function(s) pts$value[pts$statistic == s]

sum(!is.na(get("FST")))                                             # 9622, as in the old code
all.equal(sort(get("FST")), sort(toad.tib_pairs$FST))               # TRUE (sort drops NA)
all.equal(mean(get("FST"), na.rm = TRUE),
          res_pw$overall$value[res_pw$overall$statistic == "FST"])  # TRUE: red dot
```


```{r load saved bootstrap object}
boot_res_pw <- readRDS(file.path(dir_path, "pairwise_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
names(boot_res_pw)
```

```{r compare old and new stats values -- delete once not needed}
m_new   <- get("M")
fst_new <- get("FST")[m_new < 1]                # same filter as in the old code
fst_old <- toad.tib_pairs$FST

length(fst_new); length(fst_old)                # should be equal
all.equal(sort(fst_new), sort(fst_old))         # TRUE if the same set of values
```
```{r check the number of stats on monoorphic loci (M=1)}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(boot_res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, boot_res_pw$estimate[[l]])))
mono <- pts[pts$statistic == "M" & pts$value >= 1, ]
table(mono$locus)            # number of monomorphic pairs per locus
```

## Plot statistics distributions for pairwise comparison

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.5}

pts <- do.call(rbind, res_pw$estimate)                 # all loci and pairs
get <- function(s) pts$value[pts$statistic == s]

ggtoad_pw = ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"), GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
             K = 2, ci = res_pw$overall, relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 5000), density_colors = TRUE)

gg_pairs <- (ggtoad_pw[[1]] + guides(color = "none")) +
            (ggtoad_pw[[2]] + guides(color = "none")) +
             ggtoad_pw[[3]]
gg_pairs
```
```{r, with mono loci, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.5}

pts <- do.call(rbind, boot_res_pw$estimate)                 # all loci and pairs
get <- function(s) pts$value[pts$statistic == s]

ggtoad_pw = ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"), GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
             K = 2, ci = boot_res_pw$overall, relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 5000), density_colors = TRUE)

gg_pairs <- (ggtoad_pw[[1]] + guides(color = "none")) +
            (ggtoad_pw[[2]] + guides(color = "none")) +
             ggtoad_pw[[3]]
gg_pairs
```

```{r old function, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 2.5}
keep <- get("M") < 1          # pair-locus combinations with variation

ggtoad_pairs = ggbounds(M = get("M")[keep], FST = get("FST")[keep], GpST = get("G'ST")[keep], D = get("D")[keep], K=2)


gg_pairs <- ggtoad_pairs[[1]]+ scale_color_viridis_c(limits=c(0,5000)) +guides(color="none") + 
  (ggtoad_pairs[[2]]+ scale_color_viridis_c(limits=c(0,5000)) +guides(color="none") ) + 
  (ggtoad_pairs[[3]] + scale_color_viridis_c(limits=c(0,5000))) 
gg_pairs

```
## Plot individual loci
```{r, , fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.7}
plot_locus <- function(l) {
  d <- boot_res_pw$estimate[[l]]
  g <- function(s) d$value[d$statistic == s]
  p <- ggbounds_raw(M = g("M"), FST = g("FST"), GpST = g("G'ST"), D = g("D"), K = 2,
                    relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 600))
  p[[1]] <- p[[1]] + ggtitle(l)
  p[[1]] + p[[2]] + p[[3]]
}

plot_locus("F22")                                         # one locus
plot_locus("1A")                                         # one locus

#all_loci <- lapply(names(boot_res_pw$estimate), plot_locus)  # all loci
#wrap_plots(all_loci, ncol = 1)
```
```{r locus summary}
freq <- microsat_freq(toad_genotypes)
locus_summary <- data.frame(
  locus       = names(freq),
  n_alleles   = sapply(freq, ncol),
  M_global    = sapply(freq, function(f) max(colMeans(f))),
  mono_pops   = sapply(freq, function(f) sum(apply(f, 1, max) >= 1 - 1e-12)),
  mono_pairs  = sapply(boot_res_pw$estimate, function(d)
                  sum(is.na(d$value[d$statistic == "FST"]))))
locus_summary
```
